title: Resource-Efficient 3D Shape and Orientation Estimation of Road Users using Roadside RGB Camera and 3D Radar
abstract: arXiv:2610.18417v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: End-to-end deep learning pipelines for camera-radar 3D object detection are well established in driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles; however, adapting them to roadside-mounted infrastructure presents significant challenges. On vehicles, sensor heights, pitch angles, and relative geometries remain largely uniform, allowing end-to-end models to generalize effectively. On the contrary, roadside sensor installations vary drastically in height, tilt, and field of view across locations, rendering end-to-end models prone to failure and difficult to adapt without massive location-specific datasets. Hence, instead of designing a complex end-to-end pipeline for direct 3D bounding box estimation, a low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage approach is proposed for real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation. The first stage utilizes any off-the-shelf, state-of-the-art method to extract 2D camera bounding boxes and associated 3D radar

translated_title: 基于路侧RGB相机与3D雷达的资源高效道路使用者三维形状与朝向估计
translated_abstract: 端到端深度学习流水线在相机-雷达三维目标检测方面已在驾驶辅助系统和自动驾驶汽车中得到广泛应用；然而，将其适配到路侧安装的基础设施面临重大挑战。在车辆上，传感器高度、俯仰角和相对几何结构基本保持一致，使得端到端模型能够有效泛化。相反，路侧传感器的安装在高度、倾斜度和视场方面因地点不同而差异极大，导致端到端模型容易失效，且在没有大量特定位置数据集的情况下难以适配。因此，本论文没有设计用于直接三维边界框估计的复杂端到端流水线，而是提出了一种低成本、资源高效的两阶段方法，用于实时的三维形状与朝向估计。第一阶段利用任意现成的最先进方法提取二维相机边界框及相关的三维雷达（数据）……
tldr: 针对路侧传感器安装高度、倾角和视场差异大导致端到端模型难以泛化的问题，提出了一种低成本、资源高效的两阶段方法，利用路侧RGB相机与3D雷达实现对道路使用者的实时三维形状与朝向估计。
en_tdlr: A low-cost, resource-efficient two-stage approach is proposed to achieve real-time 3D shape and orientation estimation of road users using roadside RGB cameras and 3D radar, overcoming the poor generalization of end-to-end models caused by highly variable roadside sensor installations.
